text: Level three, question six: tea at thirty and forty rupees a kilogram is mixed in the ratio two to three and sold at a profit of twenty-five percent; find the selling price. Question seven: fresh grapes are eighty percent water and dried grapes are ten percent water; how much dried grapes come from forty-five kilograms of fresh grapes? Question eight: in what ratio must water be mixed with milk to gain twenty percent by selling the mixture at the cost price of milk?
